A new leak reveals that one of the most popular Apple Watch faces — Modular — will receive several new color customization options in watchOS 27. Details below.

Modular face to gain new color customization options in watchOS 27

Apple plans to expand the customization options for the Modular face in watchOS 27.

Modular has become a favorite among many users thanks to its flexibility. It can display multiple complications simultaneously and customize the face's appearance through different color options.

Aaron Perris discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 shows watchOS 27 will add nine new color options to Modular.

This beta version does not yet have preview images of these nine new colors. However, Perris found their names in the beta code.

Some of the new colors are very likely previews set to match the new bands launching next month alongside the Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4.

In addition, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple will be introducing a brand-new Modular face in watchOS 27, inspired by the Modular Ultra.

Which face do you use most often? Feel free to share in the comments section.
